symbol.desc: A rounded branching cactus grows through the soil and rim of a clay pot.
Eight broad veined succulent leaves form a balanced rosette inside a round soil rim.
Three veined leaves emerge from the soil of a round-rimmed clay houseplant pot.
A small potted plant is paired with a joined golden care cross badge.
Three balanced colored menu bars inside a rounded cream tile.
Two offset photo prints have complete frames and a clipped mountain scene.
A balanced circular day-and-night control combines a sunlit half and a crescent with star.
A compact blue printer feeds a cream page with green printed lines.
A clear glass magnifier has a blue lens and a joined terracotta handle.
A green spreadsheet document has a folded corner and a clear four-cell table.
A golden pot-label tag has a reinforced hole and two aligned writing lines.
A simple green sprout joins a short soil baseline.
A flowering stem with two joined leaves and a purple blossom.
Four distinct labeled compartments sit inside a blue inventory tray.
A botanical identification tag combines a leaf specimen and a small magnifier.
A green verification shield with a cream check mark.
A small greenhouse-like source building has a clear roof, entrance, and window.
A bound calendar page with clear weekday cells and one checked date.
A cream clock face with twelve clear tick marks and balanced hands.
A two-prong plug joins a curved green cable and a terracotta outlet.
A blue clock is encircled by a clear backward history arrow.
A warm paper shopping bag has a secure handle and botanical leaf emblem.
An outward arrow leaves an open blue square through its top-right corner.
A golden sun with evenly spaced rays illuminates a small green leaf.
A shaded blue water drop has a clear tip and a gentle ripple underneath.
A single tapered clay pot has an open soil rim and a joined young sprout.
A red thermometer has clear graduations and a small blue frost symbol.
A capped green nutrient bottle with a leaf label and a measured blue drop.
Three rounded blue air currents pass a green leaf.
Five softly shaded purple petals surround a golden center on a short leafy stem.
A protective garden glove with a warm reinforced palm and joined fingers.
A magnifying glass frames a small botanical specimen.
A warm heart carries a small green leaf for attentive plant care.
A rounded golden warning triangle with a dark terracotta exclamation mark.
Layered green mountain slopes meet blue water beneath a golden sun.
An open storybook has flowing page lines and a golden story star.
A rooted green sprout rises beside a small upward gold growth arrow.
An open field guide pairs a green botanical cover with cream illustrated pages.
A cream chart card shows a clear rising blue line and colored measurement points.
A folded garden map shows connected paths and green planting beds.
A blue phone frame surrounds a cream display with a small green leaf.
A sharpened golden pencil with a rose eraser and a clean writing line.
A digital blue scale has a readable display, balanced foot plates, and a gold center button.
Four outward corner arrows inside a rounded cream frame.
Two opposing curved arrows make a balanced blue-and-green refresh loop.
A descending green arrow aligned with a blue file tray.
An open blue eye with a green iris and a clear pupil.
A blue eye crossed by a terracotta privacy slash.
A backward blue reset arrow surrounds a small terracotta cross.
A diagonal gold ruler with evenly spaced ticks and green measurement corners.
A broad right-pointing arrow with a blue-green shaft and warm inset highlight.
A broad left-pointing arrow with a blue-green shaft and warm inset highlight.
A broad down-pointing arrow with a blue-green shaft and warm inset highlight.
A green circular button with a clear cream check mark.
A lavender circular button with a centered cream minus.
A broad up-pointing arrow with a blue-green shaft and warm inset highlight.
A blue camera with a centered glass lens, grip, and shutter button.
A botanical research page is paired with a detailed magnifying glass.
Three balanced four-point sparkles in gold, green, and lavender.
A blue information disc with a legible cream lowercase information mark.
Three stacked sheets and numbered-position dots indicate entries waiting to be sent.
A blue paper plane has a single aligned fold and a green underside.
A terracotta bin has an attached lid handle and evenly spaced vertical slots.
A cream list panel with three colored bullets and three aligned text rows.
One rounded plant card holds a rooted green sprout.
Two overlapping plant cards indicate a group of plants.
A cream note sheet has clean writing lines and an attached sharpened pencil.
A six-legged beetle has a joined head, antennae, and terracotta wing covers.
A curved blue rotation arrow wraps around a rooted green plant.
A soft cleaning brush sweeps beside two small sparkles.
Open pruning shears have two hollow handles, meeting steel blades, and a centered pivot.
A rooted plant moves from a small pot into a larger open clay pot.
Cracked tan soil beneath a small golden sun indicates a dry check.
A blue water drop rests above a soil section with a small rooted leaf.
A wide clay planter contains a purple rosette and two upright green leaves.
A healthy rooted sprout with a small blue droplet and golden vitality sparkle.
A round golden sun with eight balanced rays and a subtle highlight.
A softly shaded crescent moon with one golden star.
A green circular button with a centered cream plus.
A terracotta circular button with a centered cream cross.
A rising green arrow aligned with a blue file tray.
A terracotta map pin has a round golden center and a clearly joined pointed tip.
A blue save disk has a defined top slot, cream label, and green confirmation badge.
